scientific_integrity: The Hasse-derivative construction and its NRT properties are credited to the existing literature. This claim concerns its Hamming circuit geometry. Finite checks supplement an all-parameter proof; originality retains the risk of an equivalent older finite-geometry formulation.
scientific_limitations: Small-coordinate circuits only (at most four); exact all-size disjoint availability only for value coordinates; characteristic two, degree at most three, full evaluation field, nonzero multipliers. Larger circuits and unrestricted derivative-coordinate availability are not classified.
title: Steiner repair geometry of cubic first-jet codes over even fields
